title: GKLicenseDat_Observed
description: Observed license JSON schema reconstructed from local code path; values not mentioned are not consumed by local license flow unless explicitly read.

expiresAt.description: Only field read by local license expiry checks: licenseIsExpired( U.sanitizeDate(e.expiresAt) ).

features.description: Cloud license payload candidate; written to app registration userFeatures in some cloud flows.

licensedFeatures.description: Feature flags list used by entitlement checks (e.g., pro/enterprise/trial/team/license tiers).

licenseExpiresAt.description: Cloud payload field name for expiry date in non-standalone responses.

status.description: Observed status values in constants and status mapping code; may appear in cloud/registration payloads.

trial.description: AccessState consumers in selectors read trial.start, trial.end, trial.isOrgTrial, trial.canCreateOrgTrial.

proAccessState.description: Stored as accessState in registration/shared state.

whitelist.description: MD5 whitelist string from server; used to update public repo domain whitelist settings.

registration.description: Not decoded inside local standalone parser directly, but appears across auth payload handling in app logic.

accessToken.description: Seen in registration/login flow payload handling; not a standalone-license-file field in main parse flow.

x_fields_not_required_by_current_parser: all fields except expiresAt are passthrough-only in local standalone update path
